scenes.caption: Watch out: 0.25 is not bigger than 0.4
scenes.narration: Watch out: the tempting wrong turn is comparing decimals by digit count, so 0.25 looks bigger than 0.4 because 25 > 4. Longer digit strings feel larger, but place value decides, not digit count. Match the place values first: 0.4 is 0.40, then tenths under tenths and hundredths under hundredths.
